text:
alex: Quick heads-up — infra is planning a CMK rotation for the SIEM export key next Tue (rolling). I want to shrink default retention for security logs from 365d -> 90d at the same time. Need to confirm RBAC impact + an ops playbook for exports. Any immediate blockers?

maria: timeline? will this affect partners pulling exports? :thinking_face:

alex: rotation window is 02:00-04:00 UTC on Tue. Partners that use the export proxy may see brief failures if they don't rekey. We want retention change to be opt-out for internal teams, opt-in for external consumers.

kevin: tagging in oncall — do we have automation to update exporter configs and enforce TTLs?

oncall: we have a job that modifies S3 lifecycle rules and a lambda that updates the export manifest, but it currently assumes retention=365. Need a patch.

irene: from a compliance angle, lowering retention to 90d is fine for telemetry, but forensic evidence for incidents needs longer. We should add an exception workflow: a 1-click JIT snapshot request that stores a masked copy for 180d with approval audit.

maria: +1 on JIT snapshot. Also: what about PII in exports? We need scrubbing before any external delivery.

alex: agreed. Proposed steps: 1) patch exporter automation to support export_ttl_days parameter, 2) add pre-export scrub stage, 3) update RBAC so only "security:analyst" and "forensics" roles can request snapshots, 4) rotate CMK and publish new key metadata, 5) run a dry-run of the export job and notify partners.

kevin: draft config snippet I can apply in the exporter pipeline: 

```
{
  "exporter": "siem-proxy-v2",
  "export_ttl_days": 90,
  "masking_profile": "pii-default",
  "snapshot_retention_days": 180,
  "allowed_roles": ["security:analyst", "platform:forensics"]
}
```

kevin: that will also let us roll back by setting export_ttl_days=365 if needed.

irene: for the RBAC change we need a short RFC + owner and a ticket for access reviews. Who owns that?

alex: maria can own the RFC, kevin will own the infra change, irene will own compliance sign-off. I'll own the rollout coordination + partner comms.

maria: I'll write the RFC this afternoon. Quick Q: do we want ephemeral KMS grants for oncall during rotation or full rewrap?

oncall: ephemeral unwrap grants (JIT) are safer. We can generate short-lived decrypt tokens for the export service during rotation window, scoped to the new key. No human manual unwrapping.

sec-bot: NOTE: Upcoming CMK rotation scheduled by infra on 1765440000. Expect automated key alias reassignment.

kevin: action items I have: patch exporter to accept export_ttl_days; add masking hook; add a preflight dry-run; update docs. ETA: EOD Monday for PR.

maria: I'll include partner notification language and an opt-out form for internal teams in the RFC. Example opt-out: "request longer retention with justification and duration".

irene: I'll create the exception workflow and JIT approval template (including required fields: justification, incident ticket link, approver). Also we should log approval events to audit logs and tie to CMK key-ids.

alex: good. For incident response: if we detect a potential compromise during rotation, hold the rotation and escalate to IR. Add step in playbook: "if IR opens a Sev1, abort rotation and preserve keys/snapshots".

maria: question about export consumers — do we revoke their tokens automatically when TTL changes?

kevin: tokens unaffected; exports obey the TTL at creation time. But we should publish the new policy and ask consumers to refresh ingest logic.

alex: ok set of owners and next steps. I'll file a rollout ticket linking RFC + infra PR + partner comms doc. We should test on staging tomorrow and run a simulated partner replay.

maria: thanks — ping me when staging test passes and I'll finalize the RFC. :thumbsup:

kevin: staging test scheduled 10:00 UTC tomorrow, I'll post logs in this thread.

sec-bot: After-action reminder: create audit alert for any export requests >90d without exception tag.

alex: perfect. closing loop — if anyone sees regulatory concerns, call out in the RFC. Otherwise we execute on the plan.

irene: noted. I'll also add a checklist for evidence preservation during incident response.

oncall: will be on rotation watch Tue 01:30-05:00 UTC. I'll escalate immediately on failures.

alex: thanks everyone.
